text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ

translations.asad: WHEN THAT which must come to pass [at last] comes to pass,
translations.sahih: When the Occurrence occurs,

translations.asad: there will be nought that could give the lie to its having come to pass,
translations.sahih: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

translations.asad: abasing [some], exalting [others]!
translations.sahih: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].

translations.asad: When the earth is shaken with a shaking [severe],
translations.sahih: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

translations.asad: and the mountains are shattered into [countless] shards,
translations.sahih: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

translations.asad: so that they become as scat­tered dust –
translations.sahih: And become dust dispersing.

translations.asad: [on that Day,] then, shall you be [divided into] three kinds.
translations.sahih: And you become [of] three kinds:

translations.asad: Thus, there shall be such as will have attained to what is right: oh, how [happy] will be they who have attained to what is right!
translations.sahih: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

translations.asad: And there shall be such as will have lost them­selves in evil: oh, how [unhappy] will be they who have lost themselves in evil!
translations.sahih: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

translations.asad: But the foremost shall be [they who in life were] the foremost [in faith and good works]:
translations.sahih: And the forerunners, the forerunners -

translations.asad: they who were [always] drawn close unto God!
translations.sahih: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]

translations.asad: In gardens of bliss [will they dwell] -
translations.sahih: In the Gardens of Pleasure,

translations.asad: a good many of those of olden times,
translations.sahih: A [large] company of the former peoples

translations.asad: but [only] a few of later times.
translations.sahih: And a few of the later peoples,

translations.asad: [They will be seated] on gold-encrusted thrones of happiness,
translations.sahih: On thrones woven [with ornament],

translations.asad: reclining upon them, facing one another [in love].
translations.sahih: Reclining on them, facing each other.

translations.asad: Immortal youths will wait upon them
translations.sahih: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal

translations.asad: with goblets, and ewers, and cups filled with water from unsullied springs
translations.sahih: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -

translations.asad: by which their minds will not be clouded and which will not make them drunk;
translations.sahih: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -

translations.asad: and with fruit of any kind that they may choose,
translations.sahih: And fruit of what they select

translations.asad: and with the flesh of any fowl that they may desire.
translations.sahih: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.

translations.asad: And [with them will be their] companions pure, most beautiful of eye,
translations.sahih: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,

translations.asad: like unto pearls [still] hidden in their shells.
translations.sahih: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,

translations.asad: [And this will be] a reward for what they did [in life].
translations.sahih: As reward for what they used to do.

text.arabic: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا

translations.asad: No empty talk will they hear there, nor any call to sin,
translations.sahih: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -

translations.asad: but only the tiding of inner soundness and peace.
translations.sahih: Only a saying: "Peace, peace."

translations.asad: NOW AS FOR those who have attained to righteous­ness - what of those who have attained to righteous­ness?
translations.sahih: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

translations.asad: [They, too, will find themselves] amidst fruit- laden lote-trees,
translations.sahih: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed

translations.asad: and acacias flower-clad,
translations.sahih: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]

translations.asad: and shade extended,
translations.sahih: And shade extended

translations.asad: and waters gushing,
translations.sahih: And water poured out

translations.asad: and fruit abounding,
translations.sahih: And fruit, abundant [and varied],

translations.asad: never-failing and never out of reach.
translations.sahih: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,

translations.asad: And [with them will be their] spouses, raised high:
translations.sahih: And [upon] beds raised high.

translations.asad: for, behold, We shall have brought them into being in a life renewed,
translations.sahih: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation

translations.asad: having resurrected them as virgins,
translations.sahih: And made them virgins,

translations.asad: full of love, well-matched
translations.sahih: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,

translations.asad: with those who have attained to righteousness:
translations.sahih: For the companions of the right [who are]

translations.asad: a good many of olden times,
translations.sahih: A company of the former peoples

translations.asad: and a good many of later times.
translations.sahih: And a company of the later peoples.

translations.asad: BUT AS FOR those who have persevered in evil - what of those who have persevered in evil?
translations.sahih: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

translations.asad: [They will find themselves] in the midst of scorching winds, and burning despair,
translations.sahih: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

translations.asad: and the shadows of black smoke -
translations.sahih: And a shade of black smoke,

translations.asad: [shadows] neither cooling nor soothing.
translations.sahih: Neither cool nor beneficial.

translations.asad: For, behold, in times gone by they were wont to abandon themselves wholly to the pursuit of pleasures,
translations.sahih: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,

translations.asad: and would persist in heinous sinning,
translations.sahih: And they used to persist in the great violation,

text.arabic: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

translations.asad: and would say, “What! After we have died and become mere dust and bones, shall we, forsooth, be raised from the dead? -
translations.sahih: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

translations.asad: and perhaps, too, our forebears of old?”
translations.sahih: And our forefathers [as well]?"

translations.asad: Say: “Verily, those of olden times and those of later times
translations.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples

translations.asad: will indeed be gathered together at an appointed time on a Day known [only to God]:
translations.sahih: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."

translations.asad: and then, verily, O you who have gone astray and called the truth a lie,
translations.sahih: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,

translations.asad: you will indeed have to taste of the tree of deadly fruit,
translations.sahih: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum

translations.asad: and will have to fill your bellies therewith,
translations.sahih: And filling with it your bellies

translations.asad: and will thereupon have to drink [many a draught] of burning despair -
translations.sahih: And drinking on top of it from scalding water

translations.asad: drink it as the most insatiably thirsty camels drink!”
translations.sahih: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.

translations.asad: Such will be their welcome on Judgment Day!
translations.sahih: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.

translations.asad: WE who have created you, [O men:] why, then, do you not accept the truth?
translations.sahih: We have created you, so why do you not believe?

translations.asad: Have you ever considered that [seed] which you emit?
translations.sahih: Have you seen that which you emit?

translations.asad: Is it you who create it - or are We the source of its creation?
translations.sahih: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?

text.arabic: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

translations.asad: We have [indeed] decreed that death shall be [ever-present] among you: but there is nothing to prevent Us
translations.sahih: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone

text.arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.asad: from changing the nature of your existence and bringing you into being [anew] in a manner [as yet] unknown to you.
translations.sahih: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.asad: And [since] you are indeed aware of the [miracle of your] coming into being in the first instance - why, then, do you not bethink yourselves [of Us]?
translations.sahih: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?

translations.asad: Have you ever considered the seed which you cast upon the soil?
translations.sahih: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?

translations.asad: Is it you who cause it to grow - or are We the cause of its growth?
translations.sahih: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?

text.arabic: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ حُطَٰمًۭا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ

translations.asad: [For,] were it Our will, We could indeed turn it into chaff, and you would be left to wonder [and to lament],
translations.sahih: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,

translations.asad: “Verily, we are ruined!
translations.sahih: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;

translations.asad: Nay, but we have been deprived [of our livelihood]!”
translations.sahih: Rather, we have been deprived."

translations.asad: Have you ever considered the water which you drink?
translations.sahih: And have you seen the water that you drink?

text.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ

translations.asad: Is it you who cause it to come down from the clouds - or are We the cause of its coming down?
translations.sahih: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?

text.arabic: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَٰهُ أُجَاجًۭا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ

translations.asad: [It comes down sweet - but] were it Our will, We could make it burningly salty and bitter: why, then, do you not give thanks [unto Us]?
translations.sahih: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?

translations.asad: Have you ever considered the fire which you kindle?
translations.sahih: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?

text.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ

translations.asad: Is it you who have brought into being the tree that serves as its fuel - or are We the cause of its coming into being?
translations.sahih: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?

translations.asad: It is We who have made it a means to remind [you of Us], and a comfort for all who are lost and hungry in the wilderness [of their lives].
translations.sahih: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,

translations.asad: Extol, then, the limitless glory of thy Sus­tainer’s mighty name!
translations.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

translations.asad: NAY, I call to witness the coming-down in parts [of this Qur’an]
translations.sahih: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,

translations.asad: and, behold, this is indeed a most solemn affirmation, if you but knew it!
translations.sahih: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.

translations.asad: Behold, it is a truly noble discourse,
translations.sahih: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an

translations.asad: [conveyed unto man] in a well-guarded divine writ
translations.sahih: In a Register well-protected;

translations.asad: which none but the pure [of heart] can touch:
translations.sahih: None touch it except the purified.

translations.asad: a revelation from the Sustainer of all the worlds!
translations.sahih: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

translations.asad: Would you, now, look down with disdain on a tiding like this,
translations.sahih: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent

translations.asad: and make it your daily bread [as it were] to call the truth a lie?
translations.sahih: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?

translations.asad: Why, then, when [the last breath] comes up to the throat [of a dying man],
translations.sahih: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat

translations.asad: the while you are [helplessly] looking on -
translations.sahih: And you are at that time looking on -

text.arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ

translations.asad: and while We are closer to him than you, although you see [Us] not -:
translations.sahih: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -

translations.asad: why, then, if [you think that] you are not truly dependent [on Us],
translations.sahih: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,

translations.asad: can you not cause that [ebbing life] to return - if what you claim is true?
translations.sahih: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?

translations.asad: [ALL OF YOU are destined to die.] Now if one happens to be of those who are drawn close unto God,
translations.sahih: And if the deceased was of those brought near to Allah,

translations.asad: happiness [awaits him in the life to come], and inner fulfillment, and a garden of bliss.
translations.sahih: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.

text.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

translations.asad: And if one happens to be of those who have attained to righteousness,
translations.sahih: And if he was of the companions of the right,

translations.asad: [he, too, will be wel­comed into paradise with the words,] “Peace be unto thee [that art] of those who have attained to right­eousness!”
translations.sahih: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."

text.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

translations.asad: But if one happens to be of those who are wont to call the truth a lie, and [thus] go astray,
translations.sahih: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,

translations.asad: a welcome of burning despair [awaits him in the life to come,]
translations.sahih: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water

translations.asad: and the heat of a blazing fire!
translations.sahih: And burning in Hellfire

translations.asad: Verily, this is indeed the truth of truths!
translations.sahih: Indeed, this is the true certainty,

translations.asad: Extol, then, the limitless glory of thy Sus­tainer’s mighty name!
translations.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
